_comment: Pinned template-deployment status vocabulary shared by the servers and this CLI (cap#402). Checked by scripts/gen-template-deployment-status-vocabulary.sh — run that script against ../enclava-paas and crates/enclava-api whenever either side's status vocabulary changes; the contract test deployment_status_vocabulary_stays_classified fails until both this fixture and the CLI sets (template_deploy_retry.rs::IN_FLIGHT_STATUSES / TERMINAL_STATUSES) agree.

_owners.cap_deploy_status: enclava-labs/cap crates/enclava-api/src/models.rs::DeployStatus — the CAP deployment row vocabulary, relayed to the CLI as reconciled_status through enclava-paas hosted_deployments
_owners.paas_stored_status: enclava-labs/enclava-paas server/src/hosted_operations.rs::deployment_db_status and the operator whitelist in server/src/http.rs — every stored template-deployment status PaaS serves as `status` (all unknown observations fold to pending)
_owners.paas_projection: enclava-labs/enclava-paas server/src/http.rs deployment/app projections and server/src/worker/mod.rs outcome maps
_owners.paas_observation_folded: enclava-labs/enclava-paas server/src/hosted_status.rs::normalize_observed_status and server/src/hosted_operations.rs::deployment_db_status inputs — normalized into the stored vocabulary before the CLI can observe them
